post_details: Hello, I would like to bring your attention to few things with UI/UX of new MD version. 1. There is no Group Tools on/off available for toolbar elements. This is unfortunate and I understand that at some point legacy options need to be removed. However there are also no hotkeys displayed on the toolbar, which was always super helpful. 2. In comparison to MD10, tabs are displayed bellow the window in MD11. This is very confusing. 3. Monochrome surface view still displays color. Additionally tooltip text overlays first option. I hope you will be able to address some of those issues. Thank you. Konrad Krzeminski.

comments.comment_body: The tooltip covering the first menu item in the windows is very annoying especially as as a new user, and the use of these is I think not a very good choice in general - they just shouldn't be there at all. What's kind of crazy is that if I click away from marvelous and make something else the active application I can move my mouse over the icons and they will fly open up but without the bothersome tooltip. You should also hide the icon of the active tool when the mouse is over these icons as they also partially obscure the top menu choice. At a bare minimum you should provide a way to turn these tool tips off in preferences.

I also support this feedback. There is no point in removing the shortcut key next to the name of the tool. Also the hover tool tip that covers the tools list is very annoying and I can't help myself but wonder how does no one noticed this before launching a new update.
Totally agree. I am considering going back to previous version, as this is too annoying. Let us ungroup please!
